records.title: KOCHI BYPASS PROJECT
details: a to e: Ernakulam bypass is proposed on NH-544 starting from Angamaly Junction and meeting at Kundanoor on NH-66. The alignment needs to be studied further keeping in view the Cochin Airport connectivity near the start and habitation near Kundanoor at the end. Accordingly, technical studies have been initiated.

records.title: Passenger Holding Area Project at Ernakulam Junction
details: a to e: Ernakulam junction Railway station has been identifies for the development of passenger holding area. The development of the holding area is under planning stage, which is an iterative process requiring optimization and the time frame for such optimization cannot be indicated at this stage.

records.title: Compressed Biogas Plants in Kerala
details: (a) to (d) As per the GOBARdhan portal, in Kerala, Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited, (BPCL) is setting up 1 Compressed Biogas (CBG) plant at Kochi designed to operate at a capacity of 150 tonnes per day of segregated Municipal solid waste (MSW) to produce CBG and Biomanure. The plant is under pre-commissioning stage. In addition, BPCL has signed a concession agreement for setting up one more MSW based CBG plant at Kozhikod.

records.title: Upgradation on ESI Hospital, ERNAKULAM
details: a to b: The Employees State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) has assigned the work to Central Public Work Department (CPWD) for upgradation of the ESI Hospital Ernakulam. The project is at conceptual plan stage.

records.title: Environment Impact of Sinking of Hazardous Cargo in Indian Sea.
details: b: The Ministry has requested National Centre for Sustainable Coastal Management (NCSCM), Tamil Nadu to undertake a comprehensive Environment Impact Assessment in coordination with State Government of Kerala for MSC ELSA 3 incident.

records.title: Willingdon Island Road Corridor Project.
details:
(a) to (d) The Detailed Project Report (DPR) for the development of the Kundanoor - Angamaly road, part of the Ernakulam Bypass project on NH- 544, is currently in progress. The scope of the DPR includes an alignment study, feasibility study, and pre-construction activities (including land acquisition assessment). As a part of feasibility study, Nettoor is identified as junction point of proposed NH-544, existing NH-966B and NH-66.
The alignment options which includes a cloverleaf intersection at
Nettoor is under review in consultation with Defence and Cochin Port
Authorities. The decision regarding construction work shall be taken up after the outcome of DPR, fulfillment of the criteria, requirement of connectivity, inter-se priority and synergy with PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan.

records.title: Revitalizing of HMT Kalamassery Unit
details: a to f: To address this, the Government, vide order dated 01.11.2024, has constituted a Technical Committee under the Chairmanship of Dr. Vijay Kumar Saraswat, Member, National Institution for Transforming India (NITI Aayog) to work out the recommendations and way forward for revival of HMT Machine Tools Limited and submit a Technical Report considering all influencing factors viz. available plant & machinery, manpower, business environment, competitors, technology upgradation requirement, etc.

records.title: ESI HOSPITALS IN KERALA.
details: d to e: ESI Corporation has accorded 'in-principle' approval for setting up of two new 100 bedded ESI hospitals i.e. one each at Perambavoor (District: Ernakulam) and at Kattappana (District: IDUKKI) Based on the request received form State Government of Kerala in order to improve delivery of medical serviced to ESI beneficiaries.

records.title: Port Connectivity Highway Corridor
details:
Nettoor to Vyttila-Arror bypass with CIFT Junction in Willington Island is a very important project. The DPR is under process. Within a month we will get the DPR. Immediately we will go for the tender and we will start this project.
There is a proposal for widening of NH bypass up to two kilometres. The DPR is under process for all these three projects. Within a month, we will get the final DPR, and after that we will start the project.
